title: Construct owned-center inverses and audit Laurent paid precision (no κ)
body:
The two-full Laurent border has a favorable formal invoice but no admitted recursive precision contract. This contribution supplies a source-bound inverse-interface construction and identifies the actual paid-site cost of one independent-error policy. It claims no new κ and leaves the selected frontier unchanged.

For all eight owned-center macros in each retained orientation, recompute the same deterministic center on unchanged capture fields and negate its fanout. This avoids reversing an erasure and adds no declared Gaussian call. The complete typed inverse recipes preserve the paid profile, conditional on ordinary persistent children providing their actual inverse at the same rank charge and restoring private workspace. Forward COPY/fanout and backward gather/fanout are checked separately.

The complementary census covers all 6,596 actual paid sites. After splitting, 3,608 rank-one jobs alone have main-output error proportional to η/ε. Under the explicitly stated independent-error, linear-precision tariff, their extra cost rejects every concave moment. This is not a lower bound on correlated, adaptive or different implementations.

Validation:
- Isolated optimized standard-library replay passed locally on CPython 3.14.5; metadata/source pins passed.
- Both inverse recipes: 16 macros, eight full 632-role round trips and ten primary rejection controls.
- Paid census: exact rational witnesses, four rejection controls and direct finite-fault checks.
- Separate implementations: all-site exact recount, 36 rational fault trajectories, 96 local inverse round trips, eight full-word round trips, five further controls and all moving-frame events.
- The registered Python 3.12 package replay and unchanged-input check passed in [GitHub Actions run 39900321912](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39900321912) at exact head `039b6ea51ab7a7efb38fc6851f345839683251b0`. No selected cold replay, full physical/Clifford suite, Lean or outer theorem is claimed.

Remaining obligations: actual paired recursive caller, Gaussian/frame compatibility and fresh independent D factors, finite-grid precision/storage/routing cost, and BIT admission. Invertibility alone does not discharge these.

Scientific base: `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`; refreshed main `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15` leaves relevant inputs, priorities and selection unchanged. [Canonical Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4611#discussioncomment-19129674). [Prior two-full border](https://github.com/Lyy-iiis/integer-mult-bounds/tree/e0bebf54d8cf8549ead24aef929fc40e44313bc0/research/two-full-laurent-border).
